speed_m_s.label: ASSUMPTION
speed_m_s.rationale: Comfortable demo walking speed; not a validated EVA speed.

player_radius_m.label: ASSUMPTION
player_radius_m.rationale: Finite body clearance prevents centre-point clipping.

safety_margin_m.label: ASSUMPTION
safety_margin_m.rationale: Extra clearance compensates for discretised geometry.

max_step_m.label: ASSUMPTION
max_step_m.rationale: Blocks large steps and drops in the rehearsal controller.

max_slope_deg.label: ASSUMPTION
max_slope_deg.rationale: Conservative demo slope limit; not a certified suit limit.

slope_baseline_m.label: ASSUMPTION
slope_baseline_m.rationale: Walking-scale normals reduce sensitivity to triangle noise.

max_frame_s.label: ASSUMPTION
max_frame_s.rationale: Caps catch-up after suspended tabs; swept checks still prevent tunnelling.

allow_interpolated.label: ASSUMPTION
allow_interpolated.rationale: Allow documented gap fill with a warning; UNKNOWN is always blocked.
